name: OpenLLM
description: LLM serving platform. BentoML-based OpenAI-compatible API + WebUI.
fingerprint_note: BentoML OpenAPI schema at /docs.json exposes /v1/chat/completions route. Auth none by default.
dork_notes: /v1/chat/completions is present in many OpenAI-compat services (vLLM, LiteLLM, Ollama). BentoML /docs.json is more specific. FP risk: 5-10%.
nuclei_template_note: ISSUE: template uses http.title regex (NOT available in Shodan Freelancer tier). Should anchor to /docs.json instead.
severity_note: Inherits BentoML CVE-2025-27520 (CVSS 9.8 unauth RCE) + CVE-2025-32375 (runner pickle RCE). Unauth inference + model upload = host RCE.
exposure_data: arbitrary model execution, model weights, inference logs, config data
